title: Catch the stars
hints: Begin with: if (game.mode !== "playing") return game; then copy the paddle and compute its new x with Math.min(Math.max(...)).
Move the stars with map into new objects, then handle the spawn timer: let spawnIn = game.spawnIn - dt; if (spawnIn <= 0) { stars.push({...}); spawnIn += 1; }
One filter over the stars handles both catching and missing: return false for a caught star (score += 10) and for one below the bottom (lives -= 1).
Finish with: return { ...game, paddle, stars, score, lives, spawnIn, mode: lives <= 0 ? "over" : "playing" } and set lives to 0 when it went below.
